title: Signet-backed signer path for Loom canonical projections
intent: Bahia Loom canonical projection must not require raw private key signing in production projection paths. Projection signing should use a Signet/NIP-46-compatible CanonicalSigner, and raw-key compatibility must remain explicitly dev-gated.
observed_behavior_before: ProjectCanonicalStatus, ProjectCanonicalResult, and ProjectCanonicalJobState originally accepted only a raw private key string. The signer-first projection API existed, but app/config did not construct or inject a Signet signer for Loom canonical projection and raw-key projection compatibility was not config-gated.
intended_behavior: Projection signing goes through CanonicalSigner.Sign(ctx, event). App startup constructs a configured Signet/NIP-46 client for enabled Loom canonical projection and injects it into the Loom client. Raw private key projection signing is isolated behind HexKeyCanonicalSigner for direct development/migration API callers and is rejected by validated Bahia runtime configuration.
out_of_scope: Changing Loom event kinds or relay publish semantics
Removing raw-key compatibility wrappers used by development/migration callers
